svg.aria-label: Six picture tiles, each with a no sign: a deer skylined on a ridge with no backstop; a deer half hidden in bushes, not 100 percent sure what it is; a deer moving; a deer too far away; a deer behind brush; a buck lying down with the vitals hidden. Any one of these means no shot. Passing is a skill, a tip.
svg.text: Any one: no shot. Passing is a skill (Tip)
